name: Gampenbar
kurzbeschreibung: Stylish mountain bar on the Gampen plateau above St. Anton am Arlberg, right next to the mountain stations of the Gampen and Nasserein lifts.
beschreibung: The Gampen Bar is located on the sunny plateau at the Gampen above St. Anton am Arlberg, directly beside the mountain stations of the Gampen and Nasserein lifts. It belongs to the Gampen Restaurant & Bar, which is operated by the Arlberg Bergbahnen, and is part of the Ski Arlberg ski area. After a day on the slopes, the stylish bar and the sun terrace invite you to linger – ideal for a drink or an après-ski stop. The restaurant serves Tyrolean delicacies and hut classics. In winter, the kitchen is open daily from 09:00 to 16:00. A special highlight is the toboggan evening at the Gampen, which takes place every Thursday with Tyrolean specialties and a subsequent toboggan run down into the valley.
